rationale: Build on the current recurrent-tail baseline with a compact structural edit: make tail carry activation lag behind recurrent block reuse via `carry_gain = recur_gain^2`, then softly refresh the anchor after each reverse-tail recurrence step. This keeps early curriculum behavior closer to the stable decoder-output anchor while still letting later recurrent passes migrate the anchor toward the updated state, which is a targeted attempt to improve final int8 roundtrip robustness without adding major code or parameter bloat.
title: Quadratic Carry-Gated Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh
